author: Stealthbomber16
body:
I rarely ever play avicade, but I think bomberman would be a fun game!

Basically either teams of 4 or free for all.

Players spawn in a maze with unlimited tnt, and if they set the tnt down, it will blow up.

The maze should probably run a classic pattern of bedrock, obsidian, or both.

Bomberman would be an easy map to make for first time map makers, much easier than other maps (I chose nexus for my first one. I think it was a mistake. Those maps are really hard to make!)

I played mini-bomberman maps on minecraft realms with my friends (We hand made them) and it was a blast. (Bad joke is bad) But seriously, they were a ton of fun :)

The problem is they would have to be giant to accommodate the amount of players that play avicus, and it is grueling to set down all the redstone torches underneath the floor. (Although you can probably fix that with YML?)

Thanks for reading this suggestion.
